Enron Methanol nominates the following requirements for the Methanol Plant 
for March 2000:

     March 1st &2nd                            32,000  mmbtu per day 
     March 3rd through 12th                0 mmbtu ( Plant down for repairs)
     March 13th through 31st             32,000 mmbtu per day
 
NOTE: NATURAL GAS TO BE BOUGHT AT THE "GAS DAILY MID" DUE TO PLANT OUTAGE FOR 
THE METHANOL PLANT ONLY.
